part.text:
Done. Zero dependencies — run with `npm start` (http://localhost:3000), tests with `npm test`.

- `server.js` – routes: home (reading + finished lists), `POST /books` (form), `GET /books/<id>` (shareable link), `POST /books/<id>/finish`
- `store.js` – `books.json` persistence (survives restarts) · `views.js` – pages · `server.test.js` – 6 passing tests
